none: PAS CAM-422215: Roman copper alloy coin
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy contemporary copy of a nummus coin of Constantius II, AD355-61, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Reverse: Soldier spearing fallen horseman. Mint as Lyon. Obverse legend reads [ ]. Obverse shows Bust right. Measurements: 12.45mm in diameter and weighing 1.71g. Reverse fields and exergue reads: //[G]SL
